items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring. Rapoport corroborated the downgrade; ETR had listed as OUT/DOUBTFUL.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practices then downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth thinned; Bateman/Walker hierarchy elevated.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes shift to remaining BAL WRs

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots due to foot injury. Rapoport confirmed.
items.why: Foot; LP-DNP-DNP practice pattern noted by Levitan.
items.implication: PIT WR opportunities shift; limited upside elsewhere.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Sunday vs Bengals. Schefter included in Friday outs list; ETR board listed OUT/DOUBTFUL.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in practice; missed Thu/Fri; history of multi-week hammy.
items.implication: HOU WR volume opens; Schultz streamer, Hutchinson/Boutte volume bets.

items.text: ETR comprehensive Sunday board: OUT/DOUBTFUL includes Bowers, Collins, Flowers/Lane, AJ Brown, others; Q includes McConkey, Olave, Burrow (playing), Pittman (later OUT), Harvey; IN Henderson, Pierce, Kamara, Tucker. Cheap WR volume and snaps/pace notes available.
items.why: Full Fri board with later Saturday confirmations/changes.
items.implication: Primary source for status + beneficiary mapping; update projections live.
items.opportunity: Multiple role expansions from absences (HOU/BAL/NE WR crumbs)

items.text: Rams listed WR Puka Nacua questionable for MNF vs Giants (hip); McVay: won't practice Sat, some groin soreness after Thu practice (unrelated to camp), likely pregame decision. Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.implication: GTD; if OUT heavier TE usage and secondary WRs (e.g. Mumpfield).
items.opportunity: If inactive, routes/targets redistribute in LAR offense

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (but expected to play). Schefter noted elevation; Burrow said he's playing; ETR Q with note.
items.why: Back tightness; adamant he will play; coach indicated good to go.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday; elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White. ETR listed OUT/DOUBTFUL; will test knee pregame.
items.why: Knee; limited return Friday; team will test pregame.
items.implication: Michael Mayer in line for elevated TE usage if OUT.
items.opportunity: TE targets/snaps to Mayer or elevations

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. ETR listed QUESTIONABLE; limited Friday after missing earlier.
items.why: Ribs; missed early practices, limited Fri; impacts Herbert/LAC passing.
items.implication: Monitor closely; if OUT boost to Quentin Johnston etc.
items.opportunity: If out, LAC WR target share expansion

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown IR. Unclear how many touches vs Rhamondre Stevenson but potential 10+; nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready to go; NE needs explosives; favorable matchups stretch.
items.implication: Handcuff/flex upside; monitor split with Stevenson.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN on ETR Sunday injury board. Berry noted concern for Etienne reduced Week 1 workload with Kamara expected back.
Travis Etienne on HATE: concerning Week 1 usage (same rush attempts as Miller); Kamara expected back creates squeeze/committee risk.
Dak Prescott LOVE (home smash vs WAS, high implied total); Devonta Smith LOVE (back in after tough W1); Justin Jefferson LOVE (37% share from Wentz, strong history).
items.why: Matchup/volume/aDOT reasons per Berry columns and posts.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE (99 util score, high target share); Bucky Irving LOVE (26% target share, all RZ RB touches). Strong utilization data.
Kenneth Walker on Week 2 LOVE: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (tied team lead). Smash vs IND that gave up big to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage + soft share + soft matchup.
